content:
Jordan: Heads-up — Mako v1 internal beta goes live tomorrow morning. Early perf looks substantially higher than current small models, need a quick capacity estimate.
Priya: Do we have token distribution and avg seq len for the beta traffic? :thinking_face:
Jordan: From the perf harness: median 128, mean ~165, p95 ~512. Local bench on a single A100-80GB: ~45k tokens/sec native, ~30k tokens/sec on int8/Q4 run.
Leo: If beta traffic is 120 rps with avg 180 tokens => 21.6k tokens/sec steady. That maps to ~1 GPU (quantized) for steady, but spikes worry me.
Jordan: Quick mental calc:
```
120 rps * 180 tokens = 21,600 tps steady
quantized perf ~30k tps per GPU -> steady = 1 GPU
p95 burst ~4x => 86k tps -> need ~3 GPUs to cover burst
Plan: baseline 1 GPU + burst pool 3 GPUs per region
``` 
Marta: Beta is scoped to us-west + us-east only. We have limited dedicated pools in eu-west so we won’t route there yet.
Priya: Suggest canary in us-west first (5% traffic), monitor latency and kv-cache hit. Ramp 5%->20% over 2h, then 50% after 6h if stable.
Leo: Cost roughs: burst pool 3 GPUs * $3.2/hr = $9.6/hr per region. If we keep burst window 3h/day for a week, small but noticeable.
Devon: Ops ask: pre-provision GPUs and prewarm KV cache to avoid cold-start token stalls. Also consider instance placement group to keep network latency low.
Jordan: Yes — prewarm required. Also plan fallback to Mako-lite (smaller parameter set) if p99 latency > 800ms for 5m.
Marta: Can we use spot/ephemeral for the burst pool to save cost? Spots might add variability and slow prewarmed cache.
Priya: My vote: mixture — reserved baseline + ephemeral burst. Add health-check that promotes reserved if spot failures detected.
ops-bot: @Devon Scaling job created: pre-provision 4 gpus in us-west and 4 gpus in us-east at 05:30 UTC tomorrow. Auto-reap after 36 hours. :white_check_mark:
Leo: Also add alerting: tokens/sec > +70% over baseline for 5m, p95 latency > 500ms for 3m, and KV cache hit < 60%.
Devon: I'll open a quick budget ticket to finance for the temporary burst spend. Tagging @finance for visibility.
Jordan: I’ll add the rollout plan and model fallback policies in the console and wire the alerts to eng-oncall. Sync 1h before launch.
Marta: One more network nuance — us-east has a known noisy NIC on rack-7 that can cause jitter. Prefer different rack for burst nodes.
Priya: Noted. I'll put placement constraints to avoid rack-7. Also adding a smoke test that runs synthetic traffic for 10 minutes post-provision.
Jordan: Perfect. If anything changes ping this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
